The '''Dorax system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the creature known as the [[Dorax dog]].<ref name="Journal7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dorax [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
